instantiate.title: InstantiateMsg
instantiate.description: This structure describes the parameters used for creating a contract.

bootstrap_amount.description: Bootstrap amount to initialize the pool (optional, defaults to MINIMUM_STAKE_AMOUNT)

execute.title: ExecuteMsg
execute.description: This structure describes the execute messages available in the contract.

oneOf.description: Deposits ORO in exchange for xORO The receiver is optional. If not set, the sender will receive the xORO.
Deposits ORO in exchange for xORO and passes **all resulting xORO** to defined contract along with an executable message.
Burns xORO and begins unbonding of the proportional ORO amount. The receiver is locked in at this point and stored in the unbonding entry. If not set, the sender will receive ORO on Claim.
Claims all matured unbonding entries for the sender. Funds go to the receiver set during Leave.
Adds reward tokens to the contract to be distributed to stakers. Admin only.

duration.description: Number of seconds over which rewards are distributed.

oneOf.description: Updates the contract configuration. Only callable by the owner.
Proposes a new owner. The proposed owner must call ClaimOwnership within expires_in seconds. Only callable by the current owner.
Removes the pending ownership proposal. Only callable by the current owner.
Claims a pending ownership proposal. Only callable by the proposed new owner.
Pauses the contract. Only callable by the owner.
Unpauses the contract. Only callable by the owner.

Emergency withdrawal of non-staked tokens accidentally sent to the contract. For ORO: only withdraws the excess above (effective_deposit + total_locked + reward_oro_reserve). For other denoms: withdraws the full balance. Only callable by the owner.
Add addresses authorised to pause the contract (in addition to the owner). Owner only. Authorities can `Pause` but cannot `Unpause`, so a compromised authority key can never grief by toggling.
Remove addresses from the pause-authority set. Owner only.

Binary.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>. See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

query.title: QueryMsg
query.description: This structure describes the query messages available in the contract.

oneOf.description: State returns the current pool state including exchange rate
Config returns the contract configuration specified in a custom [`Config`] structure
Returns xORO total supply. Duplicates TotalSupplyAt { timestamp: None } logic but kept for backward compatibility.
Returns total ORO staked in the contract (excluding locked unbonding amounts).
BalanceAt returns xORO balance of the given address at the given timestamp. Returns current balance if timestamp unset.
TotalSupplyAt returns xORO total token supply at the given timestamp. Returns current total supply if timestamp unset.
Returns total ORO currently in unbonding period.
Returns all pending unbonding entries for the given address.
Returns the configured unbonding period in seconds.
Returns all pending rewards for the given address.
Returns the addresses currently in the pause-authority set. The owner has implicit pause authority and is NOT included.

migrate.title: MigrateMsg
migrate.description: Message used to trigger a contract migration.

balance_at.title: Uint128

config.title: Config
config.description: This structure stores the main parameters for the staking contract.

bootstrap_amount.description: The bootstrap amount for pool initialization

paused.description:
Whether the contract is paused.

`#[serde(default)]` is load-bearing: any legacy on-chain bytes serialised before `paused` was added (pre-2.2.0) deserialise as `false`, so a `CONFIG.load()` after `migrate` from such a version succeeds without the migrate handler having to rewrite Config. The matching default-on-deserialisation behaviour is what makes the migration path lazy and safe. (Audit N-2.)

Decimal.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 (which is (2^128 - 1) / 10^18)

total_deposit.title: Uint128

total_locked.title: Uint128

total_shares.title: Uint128

total_supply_at.title: Uint128

UnbondingEntry.description: A single pending unbonding entry for a user.

oro_amount.description: The fixed ORO amount to be returned, calculated at the time of Leave.

receiver.description: The address that will receive the funds when Claim is called.

reward_coins.description: Accrued reward tokens to be returned alongside ORO.

unlock_time.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) after which ORO can be claimed.
